snippet.title: Backframes: Escape Together - New coop horror game | Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Backframes: Escape Together is coming to PC! Watch the teaser trailer for this upcoming psychological horror game, where fear, tension, and mystery meet.

Stay tuned for more updates on the development process, gameplay mechanics, and behind-the-scenes footage.

🎮 Wishlist on Steam:  https://store.steampowered.com/app/3344520/Slendrina_Escape_Together/
